notes.title: Update 1.9
notes.notes:
In update 1.9:

• Added Broken Chiptunes DLC with four extra-hard levels
• Added French language
• Added global high score tables for each level
• Fixed and added missing German translations (thx. to alberta.alberich)
• Improved graphics (added SSAA shader (can be disabled in settings))
• Improved performance with long game sessions
• Fixed an exploit with local records
• Fixed a bug with launch parameters
• Fixed a bug with mouse cursor in the tutorial
• Fixed other small bugs
